name: Michael Vincent
title: Independent Consultant — Packaging Development and Sourcing
bio:
Michael Vincent is a strategic business leader and consultant with food packaging, engineering, product development, quality assurance, strategic sourcing, sustainable business practices and strategic managerial experience.

He works through The Sustainable Package, LLC, his independent consulting practice based in Dublin, California.

expertise.d: Packaging development and package engineering, from the first concept through the specification that goes to the line.
Innovation and ideation, product development and project management, including the patents that come out of the work.
Sustainable business practices treated as a design input rather than a report written after the pack is chosen.
Strategic sourcing, category reviews and bids, contracts and supplier negotiation.
Market development, plus retail and retailer score carding — what a buyer measures before a listing is approved.
Facility audits, specifications, regulatory reviews, public speaking and expert witness work.
